_note: Frozen setup versions (MT-G10). Change a parameter or a listed code file -> CODE_HASH_MISMATCH at startup and the setup runs shadow-only until a new version is registered. EXPLORATORY: 1 share, results never count as proof of an edge. model_slip_bps = the lab backtest's 'realistic' cost per side (lab/scalp/backtest.py COSTS['realistic'], 1.5 bps): MT-G3 holds a setup in shadow when its median slippage over >= 30 fills passes 1.5x it, MT-G13 at 2x. backtest_mean_r is null because the backtest has no R for the live bracket (overlay stops, 1 share): the MT-G13 CUSUM stays OFF until a baseline is registered. uses_volume (MT-G35): a setup that decides on volume runs shadow-only on the IEX live feed.

setups.source: Zarattini & Aziz (2023), Can Day Trading Really Be Profitable? SSRN 4416622 https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=4416622 ; tested in reports/Minute trading backtest results.md (lost after costs out of sample)
deviations: Long only: short signals are rejected as SHORT_DISABLED and logged as shadow trades (shorts need the owner's OK).
Everything is flat by 15:50 (MT-G20 flatten), not at the backtest's 15:55 open.
Live bars and quotes are IEX (real time, free plan); the backtest used SIP bars (FEED_MISMATCH, MT-G35).
Entry is a marketable buy limit at ask + min($0.02, 0.05%) sent a second or so after the signal bar closes; the backtest filled at the next bar's open with a modelled cost.

The stop leg is a stop-limit with its limit max($0.05, half the stop distance) below the stop, so a fast drop can leave it unfilled (then the stop watchdog sells); the backtest filled stops at the stop price.
Size is 1 share (EXPLORATORY lane); the backtest used $1,000 of notional per trade.
Half days are not traded (the backtest skipped them).
Target is 10R measured from the entry limit (not the fill); stop is the other end of the first 5-minute candle, rounded down to the cent.
The paper sized at 1% risk with up to 4x leverage; here it is 1 share.

Its band_or_vwap exit uses the session VWAP, i.e. volume (MT-G35): on the free IEX live feed the VWAP is built from a few % of trades, so the setup runs SHADOW-only (decisions logged, no orders) until it runs on a SIP live feed.
